The Greek philosopher Anaxagoras lived in the fifth century BCE and wrote most of his works in Athens. He served as a kind of adviser to the Athenian democrat Pericles. Anaxagoras is known to have opposed the religious myths that, at the time, were especially important to the ideology of the Greek aristocracy.↩︎
